reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: middleware is an exported Next.js framework entry point — public API exception applies, no internal callers required. Gate 2: attack entry point is an unauthenticated external HTTP request with forged cookies — untrusted by definition, no trust_assumptions override. Gate 3: src/app/api/ and force-logout-all time gate bypass are explicitly in scope. Code confirmed at middleware.ts L33-46: `if (oauthUserId && oauthToken) return NextResponse.next()` performs zero server-side session validation. An attacker can trigger this via an external HTTP GET to `/api/admin/force-logout-all` during the 22:50–23:50 JST window by supplying `Cookie: oauth_user_id=x; oauth_access_token=x`, causing the middleware to pass (L38) and `forceLogoutAll()` to execute with no authentication whatsoever. Additionally, any user whose STEM OAuth token is server-side revoked retains full application access until cookie expiry (maxAge) because revocation is never verified.
